why: A sculpted body with nothing under it. Every walk and light instrument seeds from grade on the box's vertical faces, and a body lying on ground that is part of its own piece is what gives them a grade; a body with none floats, and what it would need — instruments seeded from a declared entry instead — is follow-up A of spec-0087, not built. So the form is refused where it is read, before anything is fitted, and nothing is written.
